senses.gloss: (Var. בְּסִים, בַּסִּים, בַּסִּימָא) sweet, pleasant, well-seasoned &c. (= h. ערב).
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 141:2">Targ. Ps. CXLI, 2</cite> (h. text <he>ערב</he>, translated in both senses); a. fr.—
<cite ref="Ketubot 104a:4">Keth. 104ᵃ</cite> top <he>דמדליא וב׳ אוירא</he> which lies high and whose air is pleasant (temperate).

<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 21a:2">R. Hash. 21ᵃ</cite> <he>ב׳ תבשילא וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. 2 margin <he>כמה ב׳</he>; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 80) how well tastes the food of the Babylonians on the day when in Palestine they observe the Day of Atonement! <cite ref="Bava Metzia 60a:11">B. Mets. 60ᵃ</cite> <he>לא הוה ב׳</he> (the wine) was not good.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 69b:2">Ib. 69ᵇ</cite> <he>דאיכא דב׳ וכ׳</he> that there is good and bad wine.

<cite ref="Berakhot 56a:10">Ber. 56ᵃ</cite> <he>ב׳ חמרך</he> thy wine will be good.—Pl. <he>בְּסִימִין</he>, fem. <cite ref="B00991"><he>בְּסִימָן</he></cite>, <cite ref="B00990"><he>בְּסִימָתָא</he></cite> (also as nouns, as h. <he>נעימים</he>, <he>נעימית</he>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 33:28">Targ. Y. Num. XXXIII, 28</cite> sq.; a. e.—V. <cite ref="B00994"><he>בַּסִּימַיָּא</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maaser Sheni 4:6:9">Y. Maas. Sh. IV, 55ᶜ</cite> top <he>חמרא … מיפוק בסים</he> this man’s (thy) wine shall turn sour (ferment); v. <cite ref="B00995"><he>בַּסִּין</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:1">Lam. R. to I, 1</cite> (<he>חד מאתינס</he> 7) <he>וחד דבסים</he> and one bag with sour wine.
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:1">Ib.</cite> <he>דבסימא תסיס</he> the dripping of the sour wine bubbles.
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:1">Ib.</cite> (<he>חד כותאי</he>) <he>ונפיק כוליה בסים</he> and it will all turn sour.
